prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer sign-in after pet adoption: Move sign-in step to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users experience immediate pet customization before account creation. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right at the beginning before they see value, with high mean duration (567s).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop controls quick-start guide screen: Insert a dedicated interactive desktop controls guide screen right before home intro explaining how to summon, hide, and talk to your pet. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding completes, and finish dropoff is high (35.2%).)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop readiness checker flow in waiting screen: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic desktop readiness checker with live progress indicator and desktop tips carousel. (why: Waiting step has an extreme mean time of 2336s, and support receives complaints that pets do not show up on desktop or app stalls.)
3: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud account safety and persistence guarantee: Prominently display account save guarantees on the sign-in screen assuring users their pets are securely backed up to the cloud. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in, indicating account anxiety.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live waiting time estimate & completion alerts: Add time estimate indicators, notification prompts, and desktop readiness tips to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting median is 201s and mean is 2336s, creating dropoff (18.7%) due to uncertain loading times.)
5: [finish, layout] Spotlight layout for home welcome screen: Switch home_intro layout to spotlight with a mascot visual component and direct call-to-action button. (why: 35.2% of users drop off at finish step despite reaching the home screen.)
6: [adoption, notification] Photo upload guidance & fallback advice: Add clear photo requirements and fallback tips to the upload_photos screen to prevent custom pet generation errors. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect during adoption step.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Story scroll layout for app intro: Apply story_scroll layout to the story screen with contextual onboarding hints to engage users early. (why: The choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s and loses 23.8% of users.)
